name: Cowberry
desc: Cowberry (Vaccinium vitis-idaea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vaccinium vitis-idaea is a small evergreen shrub in the heath family, Ericaceae. It is known colloquially as the lingonberry, partridgeberry, foxberry, mountain cranberry, or cowberry.
